correctness.rationale: For all beta,kappa>0 and Gaussian STFT normalization g(t)=2^(1/4)exp(-pi*t^2), rederived rho=1+(log I)''/(4pi)=4pi Var_P(X)=m'(R). The mean-transport integral gives ∫_0^R(rho-1)=m(R)-R. The beta<1 saddle implies this tends to zero; for beta=1 the exact half-line Gaussian-erfc expression yields the exponentially small coefficient and finite deficit kappa/(4pi); for 1<beta<2 the concave/convex local potential yields the R^(beta-2) correction; beta=2 is Gaussian conjugacy; beta>2 uses saddle a_R~(4pi R/(kappa beta))^(1/(beta-1)) and precision kappa beta(beta-1)a_R^(beta-2). These establish the full pointwise five-case theorem, not just numerical samples. Differentiations of an exponentially tiny erfc remainder require care, addressed via exact erfc formula. No uniform beta-boundary asymptotic asserted.
